增强健壮性：铁律补充记忆当数据防注入/快照精简，sum 支持非git仓库与写后自校验，init 加新鲜度检查+可执行计划，profile/clear 自校验，新增'异常处理与恢复'章节，提醒节流

Initial release of wdp-ctx: persistent, resumable project context management with multi-layer storage and seamless agent handoff.

- Supports saving, loading, verifying, exporting, and clearing project context across sessions and agents, via `/wdp-ctx` with subcommands: sum, init, profile, verify, export, list, clear.
- Implements a dual-layer context model: stable info (profile.md) and incremental snapshots (timestamped .md), supporting asynchronous project state capture.
- Robust subcommand set covering snapshotting, project profiling, drift verification, AGENTS.md export, listing, and safe clearing (with confirmation and retention options).
- Operates on a dedicated summaries/ directory at project or user level, auto-choosing location.
- Built-in usage documentation, anti-pattern guidance, and proactive reminders to keep context accurate and up-to-date.
